description: Check one of the developer's own capabilities: its status (draft / review / live / suspended) and how far the publishing checklist has got. Needs the developer's Qumge key. (Older clients may still call this tool as app_status.)

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: cap_status
